tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List every app in the Spark catalogue: id, name, tagline, description, tags, homepage and store or repository links. Read-only. Small enough to read in full, so prefer this over search when the question is about the range of apps rather than a specific one.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Get one app from the Spark catalogue by its id, with its full description, tags and links. Read-only. If the id is unknown the result lists every valid id, so there is no need to guess twice.

tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Search the Spark catalogue by keyword across app names, taglines, descriptions and tags, optionally narrowed to a single tag. Read-only. Pass an empty query with a tag to list everything carrying that tag.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List every tag used across the Spark catalogue with how many apps carry it, most used first. Read-only. Use this before search_apps to pick a tag that actually exists.
